caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass tumbler that is rendered in shades of blue. The glass has a cylindrical shape with straight sides, and its rim is slightly thicker and rounded, indicating the edge. The interior of the glass is visible from the vantage point, showing a curved bottom. The blue color is darker in areas suggesting shadows and lighter where light is reflected off the surface of the glass, especially along the side and the rim. The tumbler is centrally placed within a lightly outlined square frame that is set against a plain, off-white background. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the composition. In the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten signature.
title: Tumbler
